extensionDescription.message: Select an image or area on a web page, paint where it moves, then grab and stretch it like jelly.

closeTitle.message: Remove the effect and close the extension controls

releaseTitle.message: Remove the effect and painted mask from the selected target

sourceChanged.message: The target changed. Select it again with “Select target”.

pickHint.message: Click an image, or drag to select an area

regionCaptured.message: Area captured. Paint where it should move.

grabHelp.message: Pull a painted area and release

eraseHelp.message: Erase areas that should stay still

brushHelp.message: Paint where it should move, then choose Grab

selectingTitle.message: Click an image or canvas, or drag to select an area. Press I or Esc to cancel.

selectTitle.message: Select an image or area on the page (I)

imageRemoved.message: The target was removed from the page. Select another target.

captured.message: Captured the visible target. Paint where it should move.

loaded.message: Paint where it should move, then pull it with Grab.

paintFirst.message: Paint an area first to make it move.

sizeChanged.message: The display size changed. Select the target again.

areaChanged.message: The target's visible area changed. Select it again.

bringIntoView.message: Bring the target into view before selecting it.

captureFailed.message: Could not capture the visible content. Keep the tab visible and try again.

captureChanged.message: The target or viewport changed during capture. Select the target again.

unsupportedPage.message: Unavailable on this page. Open a regular web page.

keepTabVisible.message: Keep the target tab visible while selecting.

webglFailed.message: Could not initialize WebGL2. Use a supported browser with GPU acceleration enabled.
